A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-combinedattack-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Combined Attack (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 6 August 2016): The game text changes: “weapon.” becomes “weapon in an order of your choosing.”. This is a slip: the lower part of the card set again with this text, with a black strip below with a white italic “E” and no title.

The same area of the previous version (scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
